The "On-policy" line ends at a value visibly above the 0.05 grid line, closer to 0.06 or 0.07.
The "Mixed-policy w/ Shaping" line (red) clearly starts at a Clip Ratio of 0.00 at step 0, not 0.15. The description mistakes the value after the initial sharp increase for the starting value.
